annotations.title: Get CT Root Domains By IP

description: List the registrable domains that resolved to an IP address when their TLS certificates were issued, alphabetical, each with the hostnames seen under it, the number of resolution records and when they were first and last seen. A domain that moved to the address after its certificate was issued is not listed. window is recent, standard (default) or extended; paginated by limit (1 to 500) and next_cursor. Can be briefly unavailable under load (HTTP 503); retry after a pause.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address the domains resolved to.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

window.description: How far back to list: recent, standard (default) or extended.
window.title: Window

name: get_ct_root_domains_by_ip
